note: BH-5630: 1 restores the builder gate: a lead review is requested only for a head that carries a builder APPROVE (the in-build review, or review-prs). It protects a cheap first pass in front of the lead. Each firing costs a wait: every push from outside the pipeline leaves a head with no builder approval, and on 2026-10-08 that held 40-45 PRs for hours (skipped_no_approve=45). 0 (default) = one review gate: a head with no builder row, or with the builder APPROVE on an earlier head, is requested when CI is green on it (the lead lane's own lr_ci_green) and no lead, human or risk-tier verdict stands on it. A builder BLOCK is still skipped (the fix round owns it), and the risk tier never signs off such a head, except a lead-authored low rules-text head (BH-5325). Expected extra requests: the backlog of stuck heads once (about 45 on 2026-10-08), then about one per outside push; LEAD_REVIEW_ENQUEUE_MAX_PER_TICK and LEAD_REVIEW_MAX_PER_PR_DAY bound them. Moved from the retired lead-review-enqueue lane (BH-5878): the worklist gates read it.
